channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The question wealthy parents avoid and its consequences for heirs
item.description: Parents often conceal the extent of family wealth, leaving heirs unprepared and leading to disputes over philanthropy and succession.

item.title: Gambling addiction nonprofit leader steps down after $2 million Kalshi donation
item.description: National Council on Problem Gambling executive director Heather Maurer had board members sign NDAs before disclosing the donation.

item.title: Edward Jones head says eldest daughters sustain the economy
item.description: Caregiving represents a trillion-dollar industry, with eldest daughters bearing most of the responsibility.

item.title: Sony trolls Meta CEO with Instagram ad for The Social Reckoning
item.description: The ad's punchline, 'Instagram doesn't fact check most ads. Why should we?', targets Meta's content policies and runs on Meta's own platform.
